recommendation: Use one minimal, identical final self-check in both deliverables. Keep all original requested capabilities and shared runtime semantics unchanged.
exact_added_text: Final source-only self-check: Recheck each claimed recipient and each reduction's preservation argument against the cited source and shared rules. Where either relies on an unstated interface, routing behavior or other premise, make that premise explicit and keep the conclusion conditional.
